description: Source code for UnsafeExternalSorter class in Apache Spark, implementing external sorting with spill-to-disk capabilities, managing memory pages, spill files, and providing sorted iterators.

classes.name: UnsafeExternalSorter
classes.description: Manages external sorting with in-memory and spill-to-disk capabilities, including resource cleanup, spilling, and iterator provision.

classes.name: UnsafeSorterIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface for traversing sorted records, with spill support.

classes.name: ChainedIterator
classes.description: Chains multiple UnsafeSorterIterators into a single iterator.

classes.name: SpillableIterator
classes.description: Iterator supporting spilling to disk during iteration.

methods.name: createWithExistingInMemorySorter
methods.description: Creates an UnsafeExternalSorter with an existing in-memory sorter, performs initial spill, and updates metrics.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new UnsafeExternalSorter.

methods.name: closeCurrentPage
methods.description: Marks the current page as full, updating cursor position.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Sorts and spills current in-memory data to disk under memory pressure.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Calculates total memory used by the sorter including pages and in-memory sorter.

methods.name: updatePeakMemoryUsed
methods.description: Updates the peak memory usage metric.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsedBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum memory used so far.

methods.name: getSortTimeNanos
methods.description: Returns total sorting time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getSpillSize
methods.description: Returns total bytes spilled to disk.

methods.name: getNumberOfAllocatedPages
methods.description: Returns count of allocated memory pages.

methods.name: freeMemory
methods.description: Frees all allocated pages and updates memory usage.

methods.name: clearAndGetAllocatedPagesToFree
methods.description: Clears allocated pages and returns list for freeing.

methods.name: deleteSpillFiles
methods.description: Deletes all spill files created by the sorter.

methods.name: cleanupResources
methods.description: Cleans up all resources, spill files, and memory pages.

methods.name: growPointerArrayIfNecessary
methods.description: Grows the pointer array, spilling if needed.

methods.name: acquireNewPageIfNecessary
methods.description: Allocates a new memory page if current is insufficient.

methods.name: allocateMemoryForRecordIfNecessary
methods.description: Ensures space for a new record, spilling if necessary.

methods.name: insertRecord
methods.description: Inserts a record into the sorter, spilling if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: insertKVRecord
methods.description: Inserts a key-value record into the sorter.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another UnsafeExternalSorter into this one.

methods.name: getSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns a sorted iterator over the data, managing spill files and in-memory data.

methods.name: hasSpaceForAnotherRecord
methods.description: Checks if there is space for another record in the in-memory sorter.

methods.name: spillIterator
methods.description: Spills data from an in-memory iterator to disk.

methods.name: moveOver
methods.description: Advances an iterator by a number of steps.
